narrative: 一只酒杯变虚。一张脸骤然清晰。
注意力发生转移。当重点是画面的新主人，而不是虚焦移动本身的诗意时使用它。
如果你需要看到焦平面缓慢地穿过一个房间，或者两个平面都必须保持清晰，这就用错了工具。抒情式的缓慢移动是移焦（Focal Shift）。
教科书式的两点转焦是焦点转移（Rack Focus）。而这个技巧是离散式的突变。
how: 保持摄影机锁定或几乎不动。景深保持浅。
跟焦器从A距离骤然跳转或硬切到B距离，不要在虚焦的糊状阶段停留。
结束时新主体清晰锐利。75mm到100mm的镜头能让这个跳跃显得更突兀。
更广角的镜头会让效果减弱。提示词：a focus change on the subject: the plane of sharpness jumping or sliding to a new fact。
对于视频，焦点从一个平面变化到主体，或反向操作。
when: 用在线索、枪支或偷听者必须立刻抢走画面焦点的那个瞬间。不要把它用作在多个平面间缓慢搜寻的效果。
vs: 移焦（Focal Shift）把移动中的焦平面当作事件本身，包括缓慢和多次转焦；焦点变化则是位置的突变——跳转或硬切。
焦点转移（Rack Focus）是有节制的两点式流程；而这个技巧不会为那种突兀感道歉。
examples_film: 《毕业生》（The Graduate）依然提供了通过焦点变化转移注意力的语法，这里读作更强硬的交接；《血色将至》（There Will Be Blood）的室内场景让清晰度在一个保持不变的构图内发生位置转移。
与前面那些“表亲”技巧引用的是相同的影片，节奏不同。是语法，不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是缓慢的移焦，或者一次剪辑。破绽是长时间的糊状过渡，或者一次从未真正转焦却生硬的剪辑。
解决办法是保持一个浅景深，用一次跳转或硬切，让新的主体清晰接管画面。

faq.q: 电影中的焦点变化是什么？
faq.a: 焦点变化是在镜头中把清晰焦平面跳转或滑动到一个新的事实上。注意力在不剪辑的情况下发生转移，中间的虚焦阶段不会停留。

faq.q: 焦点变化 vs 移焦
faq.a: 移焦把焦平面的移动过程当作句子本身，可以缓慢也可以连续；焦点变化是离散式的位置转移：跳转或硬切，新的事实接管画面。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用焦点变化？
faq.a: 当一个新的平面必须立刻抢走画面时使用它。如果你想看到虚焦缓慢游走，或者两个主体都必须保持清晰，就跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写焦点变化的提示词？
faq.a: 写下 "Focus change on [Subject], the plane of sharpness jumping or sliding to a new fact"。说明两个焦平面。对于视频，让焦点切换到主体上或移开，中间虚焦阶段要短。

It is the wrong tool if you need to watch the plane walk slowly through a room, or if both planes must stay sharp. A lyric travel is a focal shift.
A two-mark textbook pull is a rack focus. This is the discrete change.
how: Keep the camera locked or nearly so. Depth of field is shallow.
The follow-focus snaps or hard-slides from distance A to B. Do not linger in the mush.

A wider lens makes it weaker. Prompt a focus change on the subject: the plane of sharpness jumping or sliding to a new fact.
For video, focus changes from one plane onto the subject or away.
when: Use it for the beat when a clue, a gun, or an eavesdropper must steal the shot at once. Do not use it as a slow search through several planes.
vs: Focal Shift is the traveling plane as the event, including slow and multiple racks. Focus change is the relocate, jump or hard slide.

examples_film: The Graduate still supplies the grammar of attention changing by focus, here read as a harder hand-off. There Will Be Blood 's interiors let sharpness relocate inside a held composition.

mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a slow Focal Shift or a cut. The tell is a long mushy travel, or a hard cut that never pulled.

faq.q: What is focus change in film?
faq.a: A focus change jumps or slides the plane of sharpness to a new fact during the shot. Attention relocates without a cut, and the mid-blur does not linger.
A focal shift treats the travel of the plane as the sentence, slow or chained. A focus change is the discrete relocate: jump or hard slide, new fact in charge.

faq.q: When should I use focus change?
faq.a: Use it when a new plane must steal the shot at once. Skip it when you want to watch blur walk, or when both subjects must stay sharp.

faq.q: How do I prompt focus change for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Focus change on [Subject], the plane of sharpness jumping or sliding to a new fact. Name the two planes. For video, change focus onto the subject or away, mid-blur short.
